records.rationale: Retain removal of duplicate cfg80211_leave during owned-interface destruction. Current path first closes dependent NAN data devices, calls dev_close for netdev interfaces (whose notifier performs leave), then removes the virtual interface under wiphy locking; non-netdev unregistration handles its own stop. This avoids duplicate teardown while retaining actual stop/unregister paths. cfg80211_destroy_ifaces equals final ACK; native workqueue cancellation and frame validation remain separately preserved.

records.rationale: Retain unified suspend handling: wowlan success/error returns directly, refusal/no-wowlan closes interfaces and drains events/works before ordinary suspend. Mark unregistered devices suspended on success too, preventing queued works from running during suspend. This is required by retained NAN dependent teardown, not a physical-platform enablement. Whole sysfs.c equals final ACK; no suspend/resume runtime verification is claimed.
